text:
Situation: Esomeprazole sodium is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East has 16.4 days of the 20 mg/5 mL presentation and 32.7 days of the 40 mg/5 mL presentation. Corvale General has 25.5 days of the 20 mg/5 mL presentation and 31.5 days of the 40 mg/5 mL presentation.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include esomeprazole sodium as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers 16 to 33 days across sites and presentations. The rule‑ranked alternate, Eugia US LLC, is not on FDA's shortage list today, but its label names no plant we could place. Supply continuity depends on confirming Eugia's ability to provide both presentations and identifying the manufacturing site.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to contact Eugia US LLC to verify supply availability for 20 mg/5 mL and 40 mg/5 mL presentations and to confirm the manufacturing site. Buyer must approve any purchase commitment.
2. Buyer to report findings to the P&T committee for review and approval before placing orders.

Not recommended: No allocation changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
